title: Neural Mechanisms of the Social Brain
official: Neural and Behavioral Correlates of Live Face-to-Face Interactions
summary: This study aims to understand the neural mechanisms that underlie synchronization of two brains during social interactions.
conditions: Live Face Processing in Typically Developed Participants
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Self reported typically developed adults.

Exclusion Criteria:

-No prior history of seizure activity. Self reported absence of recreational drugs at time of study.
